metadata.title: The star grinder in the Galactic centre. Uncovering the highly compact central stellar-mass black hole cluster

notes: No eligible stars. S2 is discussed only through its orbital apocentre as a constraint on extended mass, not as a Galactic unbound candidate (T:p3-b5; T:p5-b4). The paper otherwise discusses stellar populations—O/B stars and unnamed Galactic halo hypervelocity stars—without identifying any individual star as a Galactic unbound candidate or following up a named previously identified unbound candidate (T:p3-b12; T:p4-b1).
